info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Ratings-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Ratings API allows users to access and retrieve ratings for various food delivery services. This endpoint provides a comprehensive overview of delivery ratings, enabling restaurants and delivery partners to gauge performance and customer satisfaction. Targeted towards business analysts and operations teams, the API offers insights for improving service quality and addressing customer feedback. Utilizing this data, stakeholders can make informed decisions to enhance their delivery offerings and ensure a competitive edge in the market.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the ratings associated with deliveries, providing insights into customer satisfaction and service quality.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving delivery ratings. This endpoint is designed to provide customers with information about the ratings assigned to deliveries, enabling them to evaluate service quality based on feedback.
